Stage.LogText: {=shdw_q2_s1_log}Your clan is now known throughout the realm, having reached Clan Tier 3. However, your past isn't letting you go. A large bounty has been placed on your head, and hired assassins are after you. Defeat them and survive!
{=shdw_q2_s1_fail_log}The hired assassins overwhelmed your forces. Stripped of gold and left bleeding in the mud, your pursuit of the black market conspirators ended in disaster.

Action.Title: {=shdw_q2_inq_defeat_title}Ambush Catastrophe
Action.Text: {=shdw_q2_inq_defeat_text}The assassins overwhelmed your forces. After plundering your coin and leaving you for dead, they melted away into the hills. The conspiracy continues in the dark.

Stage.LogText: {=shdw_q2_s2_log}You defeated the hired assassins and survived. Find {KatilKomutan_Link} waiting on the map and interrogate him.
{=shdw_q2_s3_log}You learned that {YozlasmisLord_Link} was behind the assassination attempt and secured the evidence, the Lord's Sealed Order. Now it is time to confront him.
{=shdw_q2_s4_log}You rejected the lord's bribe. Now you must speak with {Hukumdar_Link} to prove his betrayal.
{=shdw_q2_s5a_log}You took a hefty hush money payment from the corrupt lord and covered up the incident. It might have been a dishonorable move, but your purse is quite full.
{=shdw_q2_s5b_log}Even at the cost of declaring war on a kingdom, you delivered your own justice with your sword. All of Calradia should fear your wrath!
{=shdw_q2_s5c_log}By presenting the documents to the kingdom leader, you ensured the corrupt lord's exile. You gained favor with the ruler and achieved a great political victory in the kingdom.

DialogNode.Text: {=shdw_q2_dlg_assassin_intro}There they are! The bounty on your head is large enough to buy an estate. Prepare to die!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_assassin_fight}You'll have to take my head from my cold corpse, hired scum. Draw your steel!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_assassin_sorgu}Who paid you to hunt me? Was it a nobleman, or the alley syndicates?
{=shdw_q2_dlg_assassin_threat}You gathered fifty men just to die in the mud. Let us see if your courage matches your numbers!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_assassin_sorgu_c}Dead men don't need names! Cut them down, let no one take our prize!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_assassin_threat_c}We'll choke those arrogant words back down your throat! Attack!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_assassin_saldir}Come then, let's see how sharp your steel really is!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_intro}Spare me! Put away your weapon, I yield... Ask whatever you want, just don't kill me!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_tehdit}If you lie to me, this field will be your tomb! Who gave the order? Speak, or I'll take your head!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_kurnaz}Such a well-armed band does not move without a hefty purse. Which nobleman financed this ambush?
{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_motiv}Hired cutthroats do not risk royal patrols without a heavy purse. What grudge drove this contract?

{=shdw_q2_dlg2}Spare my life! The order was given by {YozlasmisLord_Link}. He wanted you dead because you crushed the gang and ruined his income in the past. If you want proof, his sealed order is inside my armor.

{=shdw_q2_dlg3}Spare my life! The order was given by {YozlasmisLord_Link}. He wanted you eliminated because he couldn't get his cut in that dark deal you made with the gang. If you want proof, his sealed order is inside my armor.

{=shdw_q2_dlg2_fallback}Spare my life! The order was given by {YozlasmisLord_Link}. He wanted you eliminated because you stood in the way of his black market interests. The sealed order is inside my armor.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_lore}What exactly does this decree order you to do? Who else among the nobility is tied to this blood contract?
{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_savunma}Where does this lord travel, and how many men guard him? Answer truly if you value your skin.

{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_lore_c}The decree explicitly commands us to feed your body to the vultures and reclaim the black-market ledgers! The crimson seal belongs to his lordship's signet ring. It is undeniable proof of treason!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_savunma_c}He rides with personal retainers and thinks his noble blood shields him from retribution. Take the sealed order as proof!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_moral}A highborn nobleman paying cutthroats to butcher his rivals in the dark... Calradia's chivalry is truly dead.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_cunning}This wax seal is worth a king's ransom in blackmail or political leverage. Hand it over, and maybe you'll live to see tomorrow.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_teslim}Here, take it! It has his personal coat of arms. The red seal is unbroken! Just let me vanish before his scouts find me!
{=shdw_q2_dlg4}Get out of here! Give my regards to your lord, tell him I am coming for him.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_kom_al}Give me the sealed order and crawl back to your hole. If I ever lay eyes on you again, you will lose more than your pride.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_player_entry}We have unfinished business regarding your hired cutthroats, my lord.
{=shdw_q2_lord_turn1}You... So you are still breathing? What insolence brings you before me, mercenary? My guards should have cut you down where you stand.
{=shdw_q2_lord_turn1}You... So you are still breathing? What insolence brings you before me, mercenary? My guards should have cut you down where you stand.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_tehdit}If you lie to me, this will be your tomb! I slaughtered the assassins you sent, and I hold your sealed treason in my grasp!
{=shdw_q2_dlg5}I slaughtered the dogs you sent. I hold your sealed order. If I reveal this to the realm, your honor is forfeit!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_kurnaz}Did you honestly believe a handful of gutter cutthroats could slay me, my lord? Look closely at this wax seal.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=shdw_q2_dlg6}I am a noble, and you are merely a mercenary for hire. Who will the ruler believe, me or you? Still, I care little for headaches. What is your price?
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_motiv}Why does a highborn lord of the realm stoop to funding cutthroats and dirty street syndicates? Are your fiefs not enough for your greed?
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_sendika}How far does your black-market network extend? Does the ruler know their own nobility trade in contraband and blood?
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_pay_q}Hush money? If you expect me to bury high treason, your purse had better match your noble arrogance.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_lore_c}Wars are not won on peasant tithes alone, mercenary! Keeping vassals loyal and armies garrisoned demands rivers of gold. The black market fuels the rulers of Calradia whether fools admit it or not. You stumbled into gears far larger than your petty clan.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_sendika_c}The ruler knows what keeps the armies marching! Bribes flow from back alleys to high lords, lining the scabbards of every captain in the realm.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_pay_c}Twenty thousand denars! Pure imperial silver, enough to hire companies of knights. Hand over that sealed parchment and ride away rich.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_moral}They say gold washes away blood, but a traitor wrapped in ermine is still a traitor. What makes you think you can buy justice?
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_tehdit_2}Twenty thousand denars is pocket change for a lord of high treason. I could bleed you dry and still give this parchment to the realm.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_ders}In Calradia, justice is whatever the man with the largest army says it is! A mercenary with a scrap of parchment does not dictate terms to a lord. Either take the twenty thousand denars and leave, or face the wrath of my swords. What is your choice?!
{=shdw_q2_dlg7}Pay me 20,000 denars, and this matter is buried forever.

DialogNode.DisabledHint: {=shdw_hint_settlement}You cannot draw steel inside a settlement!
DialogNode.Text: {=shdw_q2_dlg8}My honor cannot be bought with coin. Draw your weapon!
{=shdw_q2_dlg9}I am taking this order straight to the ruler. Justice will be served.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_santaj_c}Smart choice. Gold never lies. Take your silver and never let me see your face in my domain again.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_savas_c}Insolent dog! You dare threaten me?! Guards, slay this wretch!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_lord_politik_c}The ruler?! You will never reach {Hukumdar_Link} alive, mercenary! Run to the ruler if you dare, but you will find Calradia's halls colder than a grave!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_huk_player_entry}Your Majesty, I bring urgent evidence concerning high treason within your realm.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_huk_intro}Greetings. What urgent matter brings you before us?
{=shdw_q2_dlg_huk_intro}Greetings. What urgent matter brings you before us?
{=shdw_q2_dlg10}Your Majesty, one of your lords, {YozlasmisLord_Link}, plotted behind your back and hired assassins to murder me. Here is the sealed proof of his treason!
{=shdw_q2_dlg_huk_diplomasi}I bring grave news of betrayal threatening the realm's stability, Your Majesty. This royal decree proves {YozlasmisLord_Link} commands cutthroats from the shadows.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_huk_justice}Certain lords believe noble blood places them above the realm's laws. I bring proof of high treason, and I expect Calradian justice to be unyielding.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=shdw_q2_dlg_huk_inceleme}Treason against the crown? {YozlasmisLord_Link} has served our house for generations. Yet this crimson seal bears his signet... Tell me, how did this document come into your possession? Can you prove this is not a forged fabrication?
{=shdw_q2_dlg_huk_kanit_pusu}I was ambushed by his hired assassins on the high road. Their commander carried this sealed order inside his armor before I defeated them.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_huk_kanit_sendika}This decree was dispatched to recover an encrypted ledger tying the lord directly to the black-market extortion syndicate.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=shdw_q2_dlg_huk_hukum}The evidence is damning. Running illegal extortion syndicates and deploying cutthroats against fellow subjects strikes at the very legitimacy of our crown. Such corruption cannot be tolerated, regardless of bloodline.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_huk_talep_adalet}Let all Calradia see that no traitor, no matter how highborn, escapes your royal justice.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_huk_talep_odul}I have risked life and clan to bring this truth before you, Your Majesty. I ask only for the honor and standing my service deserves.
{=shdw_q2_dlg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=shdw_q2_dlg11}Accusing a noble is a grave matter, yet the seal is undeniably his. Such treachery shall not go unpunished. You have the realm's gratitude, and you shall be rewarded accordingly.
